facts.text: Asian Champions Trophy: India beat Korea **8-0** in Jalandhar; the knockouts move to **Mohali**.

facts.text: Indian Navy beat Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) 5-4 in a penalty shootout to win the **97th All-India MCC-Murugappa Gold Cup** hockey title in Chennai.

facts.text: Asian Champions Trophy: India beat **Japan 4-1** to reach the semifinals (Abhishek, in his 150th match, scored twice).

facts.text: Asian Champions Trophy (Jalandhar): India beat **China 5-2** (Sukhjeet Singh 2, Harmanpreet Singh 2, Jugraj Singh). India coach: **Craig Fulton**.
